drug_name_to_taxon.method: deterministic 20% holdout; exact normalised match then char-bigram Jaccard>=0.6

tcm_nature.detail: warm (溫/熱) vs volatile-rich compound classes: AUC=0.553, p=0.3606; Spearman(warmth, volatility)=+0.180 (p=0.0759); Spearman(warmth, polarity)=-0.240

tcm_channel.detail: channel-predicted organ vs recorded indication organ over 155 (drug, use) pairs from 90 drugs: hit rate 0.271, permutation mean 0.143, one-sided p=0.0010. Set-valued predictors have no natural AUC; hit rate is the direct statistic.

ayurveda_virya.detail: Spearman(hot vīrya, thermolability)=-0.180 (p=0.3377); Spearman(hot vīrya, volatility)=+0.000

tridosha.detail: mean Jaccard(predicted action classes from doṣa effect, observed action classes)=0.160; permutation mean 0.134; p=0.0270

target_plausibility.definition: compound class has a textbook target/pathway prior matching the indication

toxicity_risk.definition: 1 if no structural alert, 0.5 for one alert, 0 for a toxicological class

candidate_plausibility.note: rubric is explicit and applied mechanically; synthetic accessibility is a heuristic.

drug_discovery.theory_fixture_caveat: The current corpus is a small test fixture whose property vectors and use-attestations were curated from the same classical sources; treat theory p-values as a pipeline check, not a finding. Real-corpus numbers are the test.

quxiangbilei.detail: colour→organ hit rate 0.057 vs permutation mean 0.057 over 35 (drug, use) pairs; two-sided permutation p=1.0000. rho is the excess hit rate over the permutation null (not a correlation coefficient). This tests whether the classical colour–organ analogy predicts the recorded indication organ above chance.

ayurveda_rasa.detail: primary-rasa predicted action classes vs observed action classes: mean Jaccard 0.192 (permutation mean 0.139, p=0.0230); rho is the excess hit rate over the permutation null.

null_model.detail: plant↔use (treats) edges were shuffled across taxa; the understudied-lead discovery was re-run. score_drop = 1 − mean(composite_shuffled)/mean(composite_real).

no_theory.detail: mean composite 0.1441 → 0.1314 without the Asian-theory factor

no_process.detail: 39 hypotheses remain when processing discovery is removed; mean composite 0.1441 → 0.1365; 6 processing dossiers lost

no_resolution.detail: entity mentions with the full cross-era lexicon: 324; with exact binomials only: 0 (0.0% retained)

monolingual.detail: recall@5 by source language: ar 1.000 (n=2), sa-Latn 1.000 (n=4), zh-Hant 0.949 (n=39)

weight_sweep.detail: mean Kendall τ=0.9416 across 10 exponent settings; mean top-5 overlap 0.88
